concept: EFS: shared POSIX file system for many Linux instances across AZs
tests: Choosing a shared file system for hundreds of Linux EC2 instances across AZs with automatic scaling.
expected: Amazon EFS: elastic managed NFS, mounted concurrently by many EC2 instances across AZs. Triggers: "shared file system", "hundreds of Linux instances", "multiple AZs concurrently", "scaling automatically".
why_not: EBS is single-AZ with a limited number of instances; S3 is object storage, not POSIX; instance store is ephemeral and local.
